title: Settings, Data Privacy, and Profiles
summary: Reviews in this topic center on navigating settings and data privacy menus, with positive comments about setup personalization but many fragments too procedural or vague to determine sentiment clearly.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise vehicle setup and personalization features, including app-based assistant settings and desired custom climate profiles.

negative.summary: The negative feedback present points to difficulty modifying privacy settings to enable a desired app feature.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mostly describe steps for accessing settings or mention settings and privacy without enough context to judge satisfaction.

limitations: Most sampled fragments are undetermined, limiting confidence about customer sentiment beyond procedural mentions of settings and privacy.
This topic includes loosely related mentions of general settings, data privacy, app permissions, and climate profiles, so the cluster is not fully coherent.
Some positive examples are sparse or generic, so they provide limited detail on which specific settings experiences customers liked.
